title: Siguran SDLC, assurance i provjeren softver
summary: Kako zagovarati trening iz aplikativne sigurnosti, OWASP Top 10, ASVS, API i LLM Top 10, faze secure SDLC-a, threat modeling (STRIDE, DREAD, PASTA, ATASM), SAST/DAST/IAST/SCA, abuse case testiranje, sigurnost API-ja i softverskog lanca snabdijevanja (SBOM, potpisivanje, licence, open source).
title_en: Secure SDLC, assurance, and validated software
summary_en: How to advocate for application security training, OWASP Top 10, ASVS, API and LLM Top 10, secure SDLC phases, threat modeling (STRIDE, DREAD, PASTA, ATASM), SAST/DAST/IAST/SCA, abuse case testing, API and software supply chain security (SBOM, signing, licensing, open source).
